title: How Local SEO Gets Your Business Into Google's Top 3 Results

segments.narration: 75% of people searching locally click one of Google's top 3 results. If you're not in those 3 spots, most searchers never see you.
Nearly half of all Google searches have local intent. Someone typing "electrician near me" is ready to contact a business. They are not browsing. They want to act right now.

segments.title: Where Clicks Go in a Local Search
segments.narration: Three listings sit at the top of local results and capture 75% of clicks. Organic results and paid ads split the remaining 25%. If your business is not in the Map Pack, most searchers will never find you.
Send this to a local business owner who doesn't know about the Map Pack.
